title.narrative: Supporting GCC States policies and building capacities for digital transformation

description.narrative: Countries across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and Yemen are accelerating digital transformation as part of their national development agendas, with growing investments in artificial intelligence, data governance, digital public services, and digital inclusion. To ensure that these transformations are human-centred, sustainable, and rights-based, UNESCO will support national institutions in strengthening policies, capacities, and multi-stakeholder cooperation on digital transformation. The programme will focus on promoting responsible and sustainable artificial intelligence, including Green AI and AI for sustainability; strengthening capacities of public sector institutions through UNESCO’s Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation in the Public Sector Programme and its Arabic online learning platform; advancing data governance and digital policy dialogue; and promoting the use of UNESCO’s Internet Universality Indicators framework to support evidence-based digital policy development. Activities will include high-level policy discussions, regional consultations, capacity-building programmes, technical information sessions, and partnerships with national schools of public administration, universities, digital transformation authorities, and national commissions for UNESCO. The programme will also support regional advocacy and knowledge-sharing during major digital governance forums, including the Web Summit, the Global Forum on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence 2026 in Riadh, the Doha Forum, the World Data Forum, and other relevant regional events. Expected results include strengthened capacities of public officials and policymakers, increased awareness of sustainable and inclusive digital transformation approaches, enhanced use of UNESCO’s policy tools and frameworks, stronger regional cooperation networks, and greater readiness of GCC countries to undertake national digital policy assessments and reforms.
